QuestInfo.name: Age of Chaos-Evan
QuestInfo.1: Mir feels the approach of the destined battle. To prepare, he urges you to become stronger. Mir suggests joining the Maple Alliance formed by the Cygnus Knights and the Explorers to fight against the Black Mage.\nSee #bGrendel the Really Old#k to become an Alliance member.
QuestInfo.2: Feeling the approach of the destined battle, Mir urged you to become stronger. Mir suggested you join the Maple Alliance formed by the Cygnus Explorers to fight against the Black Mage.\nYou met #bGrendel the Really Old#k, who saw your great potential for magic. Grendel asked you to join the Alliance.
QuestInfo.summary: Talk to Grendel the Really Old

0.0: You feel that, #b#h0##k? I feel...destiny moving! I can feel it in the wind! It reminds me of that day a long time ago...
0.1: We have to be prepared this time. We have to end it. Let's work with the other warriors to make our own destiny.

yes.0: I heard that the Cygnus Knights and the Explorers are forming something called a 'Maple Alliance.' Doesn't that sound fun? Let's join! I bet #bGrendel the Really Old#k in Ellinia will let us in if we nag him. Come on!

no.0: Hey! I thought we were heroes!

1.0: Who might you be? What brings you here?\r\n#L0##bI want to join the Maple Alliance!#l\n#k
1.1: You're a bit young, aren't you? Do you know why we formed the Maple Alliance?\r\n#L0##bUm...All I know is that Mir said a strange wind is blowing, or something. Mir thinks we should join, so I know it's true.#l\n#k
1.2: Mir?... Oh my, has that dragon next to you been here the whole time?! Hmm...yes, I can sense ancient magics at work here. This Onyx Dragon's powers are still dormant, but not for much longer... Very well, I shall recommend you to the Alliance.

yes.0: You must train to become of one mind with your dragon. It has great power, but it has yet to reach its full potential. The Alliance will contact you shortly.

npc.0: I heard that the Cygnus Knights and the Explorers are forming something called a 'Maple Alliance.' Doesn't that sound fun? Let's join! I bet #bGrendel the Really Old#k in Ellinia will let us in if we nag him. Come on!
